request.description: List all webhook destinations (unpaginated array, oldest first). Each row includes URL, subscribed events, and delivery health metrics. The signing secret is NOT included in the list — fetch a single destination (`GET /v3/webhook/destinations/{destination_uuid}/`) to read `secret_shared_key`.

request.description: Create a webhook destination. The response includes the auto-generated `secret_shared_key` HMAC signing secret (also readable later via `GET /v3/webhook/destinations/{destination_uuid}/`). Always send `subscribed_events` with at least one event (no wildcards): an explicit empty list is rejected with 400, and omitting the field creates a destination subscribed to nothing, which never receives a webhook. The `(application, url)` pair must be unique among non-deleted destinations.

response.name: Destination created. `secret_shared_key` is the HMAC signing secret — store it now.
